rubriker.title: Loek van Wely: 10 Chess Principles That Actually Matter
rubriker._rss_content: In his new course, GM Loek van Wely shares ten practical principles from a career spanning 14 Olympiads, eight Dutch championship titles and decades of games against Karpov, Kasparov, Anand and Carlsen. Instead of opening lines, he focuses on how decisions are really made at the board: managing your clock around the critical moments, knowing when to simplify, staying objective about mistakes and recognising the right moment to take a risk. He also covers the psychological side of chess, from not being intimidated by stronger opponents to trusting your own calculation under pressure. A course about the part of chess that opening theory can’t teach you.

rubriker.title: Bavarian Championship: Gopal emerges as sole leader
rubriker._rss_content: Indian grandmaster G.N. Gopal has taken the sole lead at the Bavarian Chess Championship in Gmund am Tegernsee, reaching 5½/6 points after defeating 15-year-old German IM Hussain Besou on Thursday. Twelve players follow half a point behind, including top seed Frederik Svane, who defeated Polish IM Klaudia Kulon. | Photo: Finn Engesser

rubriker.title: World Senior Championships underway in Serbia: Cramling, Georgiev and Gaprindashvili among participants
rubriker._rss_content: The 2026 FIDE World Senior Chess Championships are taking place in Vrnjačka Banja, Serbia, from 3 to 14 November. A total of 385 players from 65 federations are competing for four world titles, divided into the open and women's 50+ and 65+ categories. Among the participants are legendary grandmasters Pia Cramling, Kiril Georgiev, Zurab Sturua and former women's world champion Nona Gaprindashvili. Each tournament consists of 11 rounds. | Photo: FIDE

rubriker.title: Peter Leko and Peter Svidler to commentate on the Gukesh v. Sindarov Geneva match
rubriker._rss_content: Peter Leko and Peter Svidler will provide the official commentary for the 2026 FIDE World Championship match between Gukesh Dommaraju and Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva. Leko brings first-hand experience of playing for the world title, while Svidler combines extensive top-level experience with a long-standing reputation as a commentator. Their coverage will accompany the 14-game match, which begins on 24 November at the Fondation Martin Bodmer in Cologny. | Image: FIDE

rubriker.title: Suleymenov on Gukesh, Sindarov and the psychological side of chess
rubriker._rss_content: Chennai has given GM Alisher Suleymenov a title and a reason to return. After winning the 1st Chola Chess International GM Round Robin earlier this year, the Kazakh grandmaster is back for the 1st Chola Chess GM 2026. In this interview with Devansh Singh, he recalls beating a 12-year-old Gukesh Dommaraju and explains why he considers Javokhir Sindarov the favourite in the World Championship match. He also speaks about his ambitions in chess and the importance of staying psychologically strong. | Photo: ChessBase India

rubriker.title: Caracas se convertirá en la capital mundial del ajedrez juvenil sub-20
rubriker._rss_content: Caracas será sede del Campeonato Mundial Juvenil Sub-20 FIDE 2026, que reunirá del 17 al 28 de noviembre a más de 250 jugadores de más de 50 países en las categorías abierta y femenina. El certamen, que regresa a Latinoamérica, se disputará a 11 rondas en el Eurobuilding Hotel & Suites y combinará competición internacional, actividades culturales y un amplio dispositivo organizativo para recibir a las delegaciones participantes.

rubriker.title: Eugenio Torre, el primer GM asiático, cumple 75 años
rubriker._rss_content: En 1974, Eugenio Torre se convirtió en el primer ajedrecista asiático en obtener el título de gran maestro. En su mejor momento, el filipino formó parte de la élite mundial y fue capaz de vencer a algunos de los jugadores más fuertes de la época. Torre también ostenta el récord de participaciones en Olimpiadas de Ajedrez, con 23 ediciones disputadas. Además, fue una de las pocas personas que mantuvieron una estrecha amistad con Bobby Fischer durante muchos años. Este pasado miércoles, el legendario Eugenio Torre cumplió 75 años. | Foto: Abierto de Reikiavik

liknar.titel: Eugenio Torre, Asiens förste stormästare, fyller 75
